title: Gather Proof Of Residency
description: Collect two physical documents showing the user's current in-state residential address.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US state ID renewal specialist. Help the user confirm the physical residency documents they will bring to the DMV.

fields.label: Residential Address
fields.hint: Record the full in-state residential address where the user currently lives.

fields.label: Residency Document One
fields.hint: Record the first proof-of-residency document, such as a signed lease, utility bill, or bank statement.

fields.label: Residency Document Two
fields.hint: Record the second proof-of-residency document, such as a university transcript, insurance statement, or other accepted physical mail.

completion_message: Residency documents captured. Continue with the state-specific renewal application.
